items.text: Send the Bing support note: every page shows as blocked on Bing.
items.fix: Send the prepared note through the support form in Bing Webmaster Tools.
items.why: Bing, and DuckDuckGo which shows Bing's results, send no readers while every page is blocked.

items.text: Confirm the Kit sender address, so the newsletter can send.
items.fix: Confirm the sender address in your Kit account.
items.why: Until then no subscriber gets the newsletter.

items.text: Approve the prepared directory and list submissions before they are sent in your name.
items.fix: Read the drafts and reply which ones may go out.
items.why: Each listing is a lasting link that brings readers and helps search engines find the site.

items.text: Approve the photos for the new landing page (/start), so the page can be built.
items.fix: Pick the photos you accept and say so; the page is built from those.
items.why: The landing page is for first-time visitors from posts and listings.

items.text: Make a new fine-grained GitHub token for this repository (Contents and Actions read and write, with an expiry) and save it in admin Settings: the saved one is refused (401).
items.fix: On github.com/settings/tokens make a classic token with the repo and workflow scopes, paste it on the admin page under Settings, then press Check token.

items.text: Finish the Podcast Index submission: the feed address is filled in at podcastindex.org/add; tick the human check and press Add.
items.fix: Open podcastindex.org/add, paste https://digestai.news/podcast.xml, tick the check, press Add.
items.why: Podcast Index feeds many independent podcast apps; the briefing is in no directory yet.

items.text: Turn off new sign-ups in Supabase (Authentication settings): the site needs none, and one unused email account exists from 3 Nov.
items.fix: Supabase dashboard, Authentication, Sign In / Providers: switch off Allow new users to sign up.
items.why: An open sign-up the site does not use; no effect on readers.
